contentText:
British girl group FLO discuss their upcoming second album Therapy at the Club, sharing how the project reflects their growth and more hands-on creative process. The group highlights key tracks including “Floating” and “Leak It,” opens up about honesty and vulnerability in songs like “Small Doses” and talks collaborations with Juicy J and kwn. FLO also reveal they’ve been hanging out with KATSEYE, gush over Ariana Grande, and name Christina Aguilera, Beyoncé and Shakira among their favorite music-video inspirations as they look ahead to touring and live performances.

Jorja Douglas  

She is. Can we swear? It’s not gonna be that bad. She’s being a real b–ch. To finish, yeah.

Stella Quaresma

Do you play the next track? Turn it up for us.

FLO  

Hey, we’re Flo, and you’re watching Billboard News.

Tetris Kelly  

Hey it’s Tetris with Billboard News, and I have FLO in the studio today. What’s up, ladies? We are here to talk about ‘Therapy At The Club.’ We have all been through some therapy at the club, okay? So tell me about the title first, and like why you guys landed on that.

Given this song by our friend Lauren Keen, who’s an incredible writer, an incredible friend, it really started the journey of making the album, like when we heard the song and heard the title, we were like, “This is so, like, conceptual and interesting. There’s so much we could write about under it.” So we just ran with it, and I’m glad we did.

Tetris Kelly 

And I mean, have you guys had some emotional moments as girls in the club before? 

Renée Downer

Of course, so many.

Texts coming through from the whatever.

Whatever you might imagine we’ve had it.
